question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A speech made without preparation
solution:
The correct answer is option 1), i.e., 'Extempore.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the marked option:

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 Extempore
 done or said without any preparation or thought. (अचिंतित, बिना तैयारी के)
 
 
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• *At the audition, the actors were asked to perform **extempore**.*
 
 
 
• ​Let's look at the meanings of the other given options:
 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 Rhetoric
 the art of effective or persuasive speaking or writing, often exaggerated or insincere. (अलंकार शास्र)
 
 

 Deliberation
 long and careful consideration or discussion. (विवेचना)
 
 

 Spontaneous
 happening or done in a natural, often sudden way, without any planning or without being forced. (स्वतः स्फूर्त; स्वाभाविक)
 
 
 
 
 
• Hence, from the given meanings, we find that 'Extempore' is the correct one-word substitute.
 
• So, the correct answer is option 1.
